verdict.rationale: cubic publishes a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its Analytics API at docs.cubic.dev/openapi/analytics.json. The Members API also exposes full OpenAPI 3.1.0 YAML, but only embedded per endpoint in markdown mirrors. The probe's 404s were on generic paths, not the documented one, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: a single downloadable spec covering the whole API including Members, a spec at a conventional discoverable path, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
